title: Jeopardy assessments, security for payment, etc.
bodyText: Section 231-24 shall apply to the taxes imposed by this chapter, both in respect of taxpayers and employers.
bodyHtml: §235-109  Jeopardy assessments, security for payment, etc.  Section 231-24 shall apply to the taxes imposed by this chapter, both in respect of taxpayers and employers. [L Sp 1957, c 1, pt of §2; Supp, §121-43; HRS §235-109]
